faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions for Morocco Travelers
faq.q1: Do I need an International Driving Permit (IDP) to rent a car in Morocco?
faq.a1: Most car rental agencies and police checkpoints accept national driver's licenses issued in Latin characters (EU, UK, US, Canada). An International Driving Permit is recommended if your license uses non-Latin script.
faq.q2: What is the dress code when visiting medinas and rural villages?
faq.a2: In urban tourist hubs like Marrakech or Agadir beach resorts, casual summer wear is widely accepted. In traditional medinas, religious monuments, and Atlas mountain villages, modest clothing covering shoulders and knees is appreciated as a sign of respect.
faq.q3: Are credit cards widely accepted or should I carry cash?
faq.a3: Major hotels, modern restaurants, and official stores accept credit cards. However, cash in Moroccan Dirhams (MAD) is essential for souks, taxis, tipping, small eateries, and when traveling through desert or mountain oases.
